name: Package
description: Installs system dependency packages across apt, dnf/yum, apk, pacman, and zypper based images.

package.description: Comma-separated list of packages to install on every supported system.

apt.description: Comma-separated list of packages to install when apt-get is detected.

dnf.description: Comma-separated list of packages to install when dnf or yum is detected.

apk.description: Comma-separated list of packages to install when apk is detected.

pacman.description: Comma-separated list of packages to install when pacman is detected.

zypper.description: Comma-separated list of packages to install when zypper is detected.
